taxonomy_interpretation.productivity_zone_reference: Reference identified outside this partition as content/library/productivity/recommendations/engineering-system-metrics; destination content is not reviewed by this receipt and zone interpretation remains unresolved here.
taxonomy_interpretation.local_integration: Use the framework as a contextual assessment lens for the existing function-owned polyrepo standard; maintain canonical controls, separate source authority, and governed applicability. No repository consolidation is authorized.

conflicts.issue: Four framework layers are not four productivity zones. A shared number does not establish taxonomy identity.
Framework recommendations are opinionated and contextual; vendor authorship does not make them mandatory platform requirements or accepted local controls.
The source promotes expert and partner engagements; that assertion is not proof that local design thinking requires paid services.
Framework consistency across projects must preserve functional repository ownership and profile-specific exceptions rather than force a monorepo or uniform tools.
Claims of experience-based validation are upstream rationale; only actual target evidence can verify local outcomes.
